what: Structured Capture of Statistical Analysis Plans
title: Structured Capture of Statistical Analysis Plans
text: R package capturing Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) structured, machine-readable form, Shiny app writing one. package defines SAP – versioned schema sections, typed components parameters – gives constructors, validation JSON file format. app form exactly schema: everything saves sap object package can read, check turn runnable study code.

title: Structured Capture of Statistical Analysis Plans
text: Install package, launch app: app saves SAP one JSON file folder launch . Point somewhere else : app plain Shiny app directory shipped inside package, shiny::runApp(system.file("app", package = "shinySAP")) works . document preview needs pandoc; shinySap() finds RStudio’s copy , otherwise runs app preview disabled.
code: pak::local_install() shinySAP::shinySap() shinySAP::shinySap(outputDir = "~/saps") # or, before launching options(shinySAP.output_dir = "~/saps")

title: Structured Capture of Statistical Analysis Plans
text: tabs schema’s sections, one one. Every item carries immutable id minted added (ds_1, coh_3, an_2). Every reference items – cohort’s codelist, analysis’s denominator – id, renaming something never breaks points . pickers show names store ids; reference item since removed reported Review rather silently dropped. Saving sits navbar: one file per SAP, created first save (choose folder ) rewritten place every save autosave . Load SAP reads saved file back every section, adopts working file.

title: Structured Capture of Statistical Analysis Plans
text: package source truth. data-raw/v<version>/schema.csv lists every field every object – path, value type, whether required, collection id field refers – types.csv lists types component may take. baked package read sapSchemaVersion(), sapSchemaTypes(), sapSchemaFields() sapSchemaVocabulary(); app builds dropdowns parameter blocks , type added schema reaches UI without app change. constructors validate component built; createSap() every CRUD function (addCohort(), updateSapComponent(), removeSapComponent(), …) re-validate whole document, reference id nothing defines, removal something still referenced, refused. newSap(x, validate = FALSE) builds work--progress SAP without aborting, checkSap() returns problems list {path, code, message} – app works: keeps unvalidated sap object shows checkSap()’s findings Review.
code: library(shinySAP)  study    <- newSapStudy("C1-001", "Prevalence of rare blood cancers", authors = "E. Burn") source   <- newSapDataSource("ds_1", "CPRD GOLD", structure(list(), class = "data_source_description")) codelist <- newSapCodelist("cl_1", "Follicular lymphoma", "codelist",                            omopgenerics::newCodelist(list(follicular_lymphoma = c(4147411L, 4300704L)))) cohort   <- newSapCohort("coh_1", "Follicular lymphoma", "ds_1", "concept_cohort",                          list(codelist_id = "cl_1", exit = "event_start_date", overlap = "merge")) denom    <- newSapCohort("coh_2", "General population", "ds_1", "denominator",                          list(age_group = list(c(0, 150)), sex = "Both",                               days_prior_observation = 365, requirement_interactions = TRUE)) analysis <- newSapAnalysis("an_1", "Point prevalence", "ds_1", "point_prevalence",                            list(denominator_cohort_id = "coh_2", outcome_cohort_id = "coh_1",                                 interval = "years", time_point = "start"))  sap <- createSap(study, dataSources = list(source), codelists = list(codelist),                  cohorts = list(cohort, denom), analyses = list(analysis))  checkSap(sap)             # list() -- no problems writeSap(sap, "sap.json") readSap("sap.json")

title: Structured Capture of Statistical Analysis Plans
text: writeSap() / readSap() (sapToJson() / sapFromJson() strings) serialise object schema: every key schema path every value encoded value type, nothing app-specific ever reaches file. conventions, decided schema’s value types: Dates ISO strings. date_range one open bound writes null bound (["2010-01-01", null]); range neither bound omitted. age_group time_at_risk lists [lower, upper] pairs; infinite upper bound null inside pair reads back Inf. scalar day count whose estimator default Inf (washout, outcome_washout, follow_up_days, …) omitted Inf: generated call leaves argument package default applies. field author never set omitted, never written null. empty parameters object {}. Vector fields always arrays. codelist’s content encoded type – {"set": [ids]} codelist, {"set": [{row}, ...]} codelist details concept set expression – reads back omopgenerics constructors, object comes class schema requires. Keys schema define survive read, checkSap() can report unknown_field. file written standalone app rewrite (sap_schema_version 0.4.x) refused: migration layer, NEWS.md keeps history rationale fields shaped.

title: Structured Capture of Statistical Analysis Plans
text: One package. Shiny app lives inst/app plain Shiny app directory: shiny::runApp() sources R/ folder (alphabetically, non-recursively) sets working directory , everything needs package calls shinySAP::<fn>(). repeating item real Shiny module inserted insertUI, re-rendered block, adding removing one never resets siblings.
code: DESCRIPTION                  package metadata; shiny and the OMOP packages are Suggests R/sap.R                      SAP constructors and CRUD R/sap_schema.R               schema accessors, checkSap(), validateSap() R/sap_json.R                 sapToJson(), sapFromJson(), writeSap(), readSap() R/shiny_app.R                shinySap() R/sysdata.rda                the built schema tables (see data-raw/) data-raw/v<version>/         schema.csv + types.csv, ground truth for what a SAP is data-raw/sysdata.R           builds R/sysdata.rda from them  inst/app/app.R               the Shiny app: ui, server, shinyApp() inst/app/R/                  sourced by loadSupport(), alphabetically, before app.R   analysis_registry.R        analysis template registry and shared input blocks   analysis_type_*.R          one parameter template per analysis type   cohort_kinds.R             cohort type templates   dynamic_items.R            add/remove/duplicate machinery, id minting, pickers   mod_*.R                    one Shiny module per section   problems.R                 checkSap() problems regrouped by item, plus semantic checks   sap_code.R                 SAP -> runnable R   sap_study_export.R         SAP -> a study directory (scripts and codelist files)   utils.R                    small helpers inst/app/sap_preview.Rmd     SAP -> HTML/Word preview inst/app/reference.docx      Word styles (regenerate with data-raw/make_reference_docx.R)  tests/testthat/              the package suite: test-sap-*.R for the package,                              test-app-*.R for the app (helper-app.R sources inst/app/R) tests/testthat/fixtures/     sample SAPs in the package schema NEWS.md                      package news, then the retired app-private schema history scripts/precheck.sh          every gate CI applies, runnable step by step
